the_root_cause.how_it_was_confirmed: the build list has exactly one C unit, mtk/loader/mtkloader.c; and the diagnostic string I added to xnuloader/loader.c is absent from loader.bin, while present in the source
the_root_cause.what_mtkloader_has: its own ufs_read() that talks to the controller directly, and no loader_block, no RDWBLOCK, no shared page at all
the_root_cause.how_it_was_missed: the two files are both called loader.c and the first one found had a complete implementation of exactly the protocol being looked for

two_misjudgements.said: the loader side is already written, only a flag is missing
two_misjudgements.because: did not check which sources are in the build
